search_strategy: Search 2022–present, since ChatGPT's release in late 2022 drives nearly all relevant work, prioritizing empirical studies (surveys, quasi-experiments, RCTs, mixed methods, interviews) and systematic reviews on graduate or postgraduate populations. Exclude papers focused solely on undergraduates or K-12, purely technical LLM benchmarks without student participants, and opinion pieces lacking evidence, unless they inform policy. Expect rq1 and rq2 to be thin on causal evidence specific to graduate students, since many studies mix student levels or rely on self-reports, and rq6 on measurement to be the thinnest.
